name: Dash
summary: The blow that lands a turn early — and twice as hard once the Nexus is out.

face.name: Dash

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: An Entity of your choice gets +2 Power until end of turn and may attack even if it entered the field this turn. If you control the Nexus, it gets +4 Power instead.

face.flavor: Before the eye understands, it is over.
